text:
priya: Hey team — Tellura Health wants a short POC to validate latency and sustained throughput for an integration. They expect: 200 concurrent users, ~250 RPS peak, 50 RPS sustained, 150ms tail latency target for 95th p50 ~30ms. Need a runnable plan + quick price/ops callout by EOD tomorrow. Who can own the runbook?
samir: I can own load plan + test harness. Quick q: what model families are they testing? seq lengths, avg tokens?
priya: They want a general-purpose 7B open model (generation for summaries), avg prompt 220 tokens, avg response 180 tokens. Also a small embedding workload for search spikes (~5k qps for short bursts). Security asks: KMS integration + SOC2 controls.
morgan: OK. Proposed test matrix: 1) hosted API baseline with 7B fp16, 2) quantized 8-bit on dedicated pool, 3) fallback to a smaller 3B for degraded availability. For arrival pattern, use Poisson for sustained and 10s microbursts every 5m to simulate UX spikes.
jess: For hitting 150ms 95th we likely need Dedicated with reserved GPUs unless they accept higher cost on hosted. Need to flag HSM/KMS — on Private we can attach customer KMS, on Hosted we use our managed KMS (bring-your-own not available).
priya: Good call. Can you sketch the cost delta (ballpark) between hosted and a 3-node dedicated pool for 1-month POC? I'll pass to procurement.
samir: Ballpark numbers: hosted tokens ~ $0.35 / 1k gen tokens (estimate for 7B). Dedicated: roughly $8k/day for a small reserved pool (3x A10-ish equivalent) during sustained run — so for a week-long intensive POC expect ~ $56k, but can drop to burst windows and autoscale. I will compute more exact once we pick instance types.
morgan: Runbook outline:
- Pretest: confirm API keys + network egress rules (Tellura IP allowlist)
- Env: create dedicated test project + metrics forwarder to our console
- Tools: k6 for RPS, our local harness for payload shaping, jaeger for traces
- Matrix: sustained 50 RPS, ramp to 250 RPS over 2m, microbursts (10s @ 1.5x peak) every 5m, embedding soak 5k qps for 60s windows
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU util, CPU, queue depth, error rate
Example k6 command:```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m script.js --out influxdb=http://influx:8086
```
Example request payload snippet:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-7b",
  "input": "<user prompt...>",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```
samir: For the embedding burst we'll run a separate k6 job with smaller payloads, high concurrency. Also recommend enabling prefix/KV cache for the generation tests to reflect real traffic if they have repeating context.
jess: Ops checklist for me: 1) create dedicated pool toggle in console 2) provision temp cert for Tellura 3) enable finer-grain logs for the POC (48hr retention) 4) provide an HSM note for security (we can provide HSM-backed keys only on Private).
priya: Security note: Tellura is asking for a filled security questionnaire. I'll attach the doc in this thread after standup. Can we commit to a date for the run? Sales wants results in 6 business days.
morgan: Proposed run date: start next Tue 09:00 UTC, 48hr active test window, then 24hr soak and analysis. That fits the 6-business-day deliverable assuming quick infra.
samir: I'll draft the test harness today and post the k6 script here. Will also include a small script to synthesize prompt diversity.
deploy-bot: test-env-tellura created: project=tellura-poc-3890, cluster=dedicated-small, ingress=https://poc-tellura.redwood.test (credentials sent to priya)
priya: Nice — thanks @deploy-bot :thumbsup: Jess/morgan/samir — can we sync 30m after lunch to finalize instance sizing? I need the cost delta for procurement.
jess: Yup, ping me @ 13:30. I'll bring the HSM note and quick hosted vs dedicated pricing delta.
morgan: I'll have the draft runbook and a sample results dashboard template by then.
samir: Will put together the run artifacts and a quick checklist for failover behavior (model fallback + opaque errors).
priya: Perfect — if we hit the SLA in Dedicated but not Hosted we'll recommend dedicated for initial production with gradual migration. I'll update Tellura.
priya: attaching final ask: short email template to Tellura with dates, what we need (IP allowlist, sample prompts, security contact). I'll paste after the sync.
